final:
type DivZero = { a: int }

safe_div(a: int, b: int) -> int fail DivZero =
  ex safe_div(6, 2) == 3
  if b == 0
    fail DivZero(a: a)
  else
    a // b

test_safe_div() =
  assert (safe_div(6, 2) else 0) == 3
  assert (safe_div(5, 0) else err -> err.a) == 5
